lay_text: I'm tired all the time and I just don't feel like eating.
It all started after I had the flu in February. They said it was influenza A.
My stools have been loose and watery since the flu.
My water has been dark, like strong tea, since I had the flu.

Now you ask, yes. Since about 2016 my water goes dark every so often, and it's been happening more often these last two years. It clears up by itself in two or three days. I've had it checked before, but they never found out why.
No, nothing runs in the family that I know of.
Nothing special. Everything's fine at home.
I've hardly been passing any water at all.
The clinic did some blood tests. They said I was a bit anaemic and my kidney and liver tests weren't right, so they sent me in.
